fullPassage: Sierra shook as she walked back and forth in front of her professor's office. The week before, she had turned in her art assignment and today, Professor Fox had asked Sierra to come see her. "Oh, no." Sierra thought, "What if she thinks my paintings are horrible?" Sierra's sweating hand turned the door handle. Professor Fox smiled and said, "Sierra, your paintings were amazing and so unique! Can I display them at the school exhibition?" Sierra smiled brightly as she exclaimed, "Oh, this is so wonderful! It's always been a dream of mine to share my art with others! This is the best day ever!"
